items.subject: mRNA-4157 Drug Substance manufacturing
items.statement: Manufacturing process consists of six sequential steps: mRNA Synthesis using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT at 39.0°C, mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C, LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at 36 mL/min flow rate, Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C, Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at Ambient conditions, and Fill-Finish with Vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 environment. All steps resulted in PASS status.
items.supporting_quote: Step 1: mRNA Synthesis, T7 RNA Polymerase IVT, 39.0°C, PASS; Step 2: mRNA Purification, Tangential Flow Filtration, ≤5°C, PASS; Step 3: LNP Formulation, Microfluidic Mixing, Flow rate: 36 mL/min, PASS; Step 4: Diafiltration, Buffer Exchange to PBS, ≤5°C, PASS; Step 5: Sterile Filtration, 0.22 µm filter, Ambient, PASS; Step 6: Fill-Finish, Vial filling (0.5 mL), Aseptic ISO 5, PASS
items.steps: ["mRNA Synthesis using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT at 39.0°C", "mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C", "LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at flow rate 36 mL/min", "Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C", "Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at Ambient conditions", "Fill-Finish with Vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 environment"]

items.subject: mRNA-4157 Drug Substance Batch BN-24681-340 in-process controls
items.statement: In-process controls passed all specifications: pH 7.01 (spec 6.8–7.2), Osmolality 317 mOsm/kg (spec 250–350 mOsm/kg), Particle Size Z-avg 102 nm (spec 80–120 nm), Encapsulation Efficiency 95.2% (spec ≥85%), Endotoxin 0.91 EU/mL (spec <5 EU/mL), Sterility no growth at 14 days (spec no growth)
